column1: # Disgaea 4 Return (Korean release, update 1.1.0, SDK 7.4) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# NIS's Nmpl engine on NVN: 65 shaders as NMPL_NVN objects in main's .data (shader_split.py #NMPL@), 69 translated; RGBA8 / BC7 textures; its movies H.264.
# Two fixes in the core brought it up: nvnTextureBuilderGetSparseTileLayout (the game sizes a buffer from the tile shape; the stub crashed its pool allocator
# when the opening movie ended) and SDK 7.4's DeviceSink command ID 0x10 (the first menu sound crashed the audio render thread).
# The map's floor panels are drawn with back faces culled and came out culled with the winding as given: the lava sea under the hub showed through the floor.
# With the winding inverted every floor draws and culling stays on (25 of ~100 map draws cull back). Why this game differs from the other upper-left games is not known
# Upstream's DM_VK_FRONT=2 is the same switch, so the row now uses that name (the old name, DM_VK_FRONT_INVERT=1, still works as an alias)
# Retroid Pocket 6, 2026-11-15 (Turnip T30): title, new game, the opening, the hub at 60 fps (GPU 2.2 ms, frame p95 16.9 ms, no drops); battles not checked yet
